description: Certificate of Lawfulness (Existing) is sought for the confirmation of lawful implementation of application ref. 23/1250/R dated 22 November 2023 for the Submission of Reserved Matters Application (Access, Appearance, Landscaping and Layout) pursuant to Condition 61 of Outline Planning Permission 19/2733/O dated 1st September 2022 for streets and landscaping at land to the west of Millennium Way and at Ordnance Crescent Junction. Additional conditions addressed in this application include 01 (Compliance with Environmental Statement), 57 (Plans), 63 (Parameter Plans), 64 (Design Guidelines), 65 (Development Specification), 66 (Submission of Reserved Matters Application), 87 (Cycle Parking), 97 (Sustainability) and 101 (Circular Economy).
site_name: Land to the west of Millennium Way and at Ordnance Crescent Junction, Greenwich Peninsula, SE10
